seed: Objects of type `hud` under action ACTION5 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: x x4, no_change x3, born x1, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 ring (9, centre 5) steps 6; move iff dest box all floor 5, or it holds the plate centre (topmost 3x3 of rope 8).
Body (player/ghost) on plate: door block (arm rows +-3, 6 cols from arm start) shifts 6 toward the line; release shifts it back.
HUD A5 mixed outcomes = ghost-mode toggle: no colour-2 ring -> record (ring 2 at (1,1), player HUD x+4, solid 1 block gone); ring present -> clear; player on spawn -> no-op.
Ghost (colour 2) = player trail 2 successful moves behind, trail reset to [level start, spawn] on record, hidden on player; spawn = first lattice cell with all-5 box.
Counter row 63: n//2+1 cells colour 1 from right after call n; parity hidden (continuity-gated, fallback n=2z-1), so stateless runs cannot pass.
